description:
Aiden is a die-hard fan of the unknown band Chasm. Just before a show, he witnesses the band’s leader walk out right before his eyes, leaving the group on the brink of breaking up.

*“Shit! How are we supposed to play without a bassist?”

“I, I’ll play bass!”*

He was thrust into the role of Chasm’s bassist on the spot, but Aiden’s playing skills were nothing short of disastrous... Seth, already on edge from a breakup and financial struggles, acts recklessly toward Aiden, and the fate of the two of them and the band hangs in the balance.

 *“Hey, if you can’t play that song all the way through by next week, I’ll bite off your lips and fingers. Got it?”*

(Source: MrBlue, translated)
